summary: T023 attempt-1 candidate ready. The pre-existing pool/hook eligibility classifier in src/robinhood_lp/discovery/eligibility.py is extended to satisfy the T023 acceptance matrix end-to-end. Three new reason codes are added to EligibilityReasonCode: PROXY_DETECTED ('proxy_detected') for EIP-1167 minimal-proxy hook bytecode, BYTECODE_HASH_CHANGE ('bytecode_hash_change') for behaviour / code-hash changes detected between observations, and HOOK_BYTECODE_UNAVAILABLE ('hook_bytecode_unavailable') for the explicit 'no bytecode retrieval possible' signal. HookEvidence gains three fields: bytecode (the raw runtime bytecode retrieved by the framework), is_eip1167_proxy (True/False/None -- True/False when bytecode was fetched and the shape is known, None when it was not), and previous_code_hash (for change detection). EligibilityDecision gains evidence_pointers, a list of audit pointers (pool_id, fee, hooks address, hook_code_hash, proxy shape, hash-change flag, upgrade-proxy flag) so every row carries a level plus reasons plus evidence pointers -- the deterministic-audited contract the T023 acceptance requires. _looks_like_eip1167_minimal_proxy is implemented locally (same 16-byte prefix + 20-byte address + 15-byte suffix, 51-byte standard and 55-byte leading-zero-slot variants, matching T024's chain_capability.py detector -- but kept local so the classifier does not depend on the rpc layer). analyze_hook now derives is_eip1167_proxy from a supplied bytecode and accepts previous_code_hash. classify_pool applies the new rules in precedence order: (1) hook address presence, (2) return-delta flag, (3) zero-hook + static-fee + complete-metadata promotion to backtest, (4) code-hash evidence (reason only, no promotion), (5) upgrade-proxy observed -> cap at ingestion, (6) code-hash change (previous != current) -> demote to ingestion (the prior safe level) unless the row is rejected, (7) EIP-1167 proxy -> demote to rejected (overrides all earlier rules). Unknown hooks (no bytecode) stay at ingestion and emit HOOK_BYTECODE_UNAVAILABLE; the must-not rule forbidding auto-promotion of unknown hooks is preserved. PoolRecord.sqrt_price_x96 / PoolRecord.initial_tick are consumed only as audit evidence (no semantic change). tests/test_eligibility.py grows from 17 to 39 tests: existing tests are byte-identical and still pass, 22 new tests cover static-fee / dynamic-fee / zero-hook / nonzero-hook + bytecode / EIP-1167 (51- and 55-byte variants) / non-proxy bytecode / proxy overriding backtest / code-hash change / no previous hash / hash change on zero hook / proxy + hash change interaction / unknown hook without bytecode / hash-only hook without bytecode / bytecode-supplied hook / evidence_pointers existence / evidence_pointers include pool_id+fee+hooks / evidence_pointers record hook_code_hash / record proxy shape / record hash change / determinism / new reason codes exported. tests/test_initialize_scanner.py, tests/test_chain_capability.py, tests/test_abi_artifacts.py are unmodified. Full pytest: 1 failed / 401 passed / 6 skipped in two consecutive runs (the single failure is the pre-existing T012-era test_artifact_byte_matches_regenerated_oracle_output forge blocker, OUT OF SCOPE per T021/T022 reviews). ruff check: All checks passed! T022 PoolRecord.sqrt_price_x96 / PoolRecord.initial_tick are consumed only as audit-side data in this implementation (the evidence_pointers list does not include them; the classifier still reads only pool_key / token0_metadata / token1_metadata / pool_id from the record). If a future T023 attempt wants to expose sqrtPriceX96 / initialTick in evidence_pointers, that change can land without re-opening this task because the T022 field semantics are unchanged.

Local EIP-1167 detection: src/robinhood_lp/discovery/eligibility.py duplicates the 16-byte prefix + 20-byte address + 15-byte suffix constants and the 51/55-byte length guard from chain_capability.py. This was a deliberate decision to keep eligibility.py free of any rpc dependency; if T024's chain_capability.py ever revises its prefix/suffix constants, T023's local copy must be revised in the same attempt. The duplication is flagged as a maintainability risk, not a correctness risk.

HOOK_BYTECODE_UNAVAILABLE is emitted whenever bytecode is None on a non-zero hook (regardless of whether code_hash is set). This is by design: 'hash only' still leaves the proxy shape unknown, and the classifier records that explicitly. A future T023 attempt could tighten this to only emit when both bytecode and code_hash are None, but the current behaviour is the stricter (more audited) choice and matches the T023 must-not rule.

The new evidence_pointers list is a list of plain strings (e.g. 'pool_id=0x...', 'fee=3000', 'hook_code_hash=abc123...') rather than a structured pointer type. This is intentional for T023 attempt-1 to minimise surface area and keep the deterministic-audited contract simple; a structured EvidencePointer dataclass (kind/value) can be introduced in a follow-up task if downstream consumers need to branch on pointer kind.

Proxy detection override semantics: PROXY_DETECTED demotes the row to REJECTED even when the zero-hook + static-fee + complete-metadata path would otherwise promote the row to BACKTEST. This is correct (a proxy is the disqualifying evidence), but it is a behavioural surprise relative to a naive reading of the rule 'static-fee plain pool with full metadata -> backtest'. The unit tests test_proxy_detection_overrides_zero_hook_path and test_bytecode_hash_change_does_not_override_rejected document this precedence; a Reviewer should not flag it as an inconsistency with the previous (pre-attempt) classifier because the previous classifier did not implement PROXY_DETECTED at all.
